sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven mature face, strong dark eyebrows and stern side glance toward screen right; compact dark fur winter hat with blue-grey leather crown and small blue-white roundel near its screen-right front. No large exposed hairstyle; retain the small visible dark side-hair traces. Long curved dark pipe held at the mouth extends toward screen right to a distinct reddish upturned bowl, not a cigar. Grey coat with folded broad lapels, red gold-bordered collar tabs with small golden marks, dark inner neckwear and black diagonal shoulder strap; chest-up crop, cream-grey painted backing, directional soft light from screen left. Tiny tab marks remain pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven mature face, short brown side hair under grey field cap, strong brown eyebrows and neutral slightly parted mouth. Cap has short dark visor, small blue-white roundel above a narrow vertical front strip with two round dark buttons. Grey-white textured fur coat collar fills both lower sides over dark inner uniform with narrow grey standing neck band and tiny gold edging visible near bottom; shoulders and chest cropped, pale grey-beige painted backing, soft upper-left illumination. Tiny inner-collar emblem detail is unreadable and is not invented.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Frontal clean-shaven younger face, short dark brown side hair below grey field cap, brown eyebrows, closed neutral mouth and forward gaze. Grey cap with short visor, small blue-white top roundel and two round gold-grey buttons on its vertical central strip. Dark charcoal uniform with shoulder straps and small round shoulder buttons, central button, grey-edged collar carrying two bright red gold-bordered tabs with small gold marks. Retain the flat close collar and straight shoulders, chest-up crop, pale grey-beige backing and upper-left light; precise tiny badge linework is pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven mature face with dark eyebrows, closed serious mouth and slightly raised gaze. Large grey textured fur hat with a dark green central strip, blue-white roundel above a separate small red-gold round badge; hair mostly covered. Dark green coat with broad overlapping lapels, visible brown-gold buttons at lower edges, dark upright inner collar with red gold-trimmed tabs and small golden buttons. Centered chest-up crop, full cream-grey painted rectangle with fine darker border visible at edges and soft screen-left light. Exact tiny badge/tab motifs cannot be resolved beyond their visible shapes/colors.
